definitions.explanation: The branch of medicine dealing with eye diseases and disorders, or a clinic or department specializing in eye care.

examples.english: I'm going to the eye doctor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かゆい→かゆい：02340_kayui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{眼科|がんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My eyes were itchy, so I went to an eye clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンタクトレンズ→コンタクトレンズ：17011_kontakutorenzu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{処方箋|しょほうせん}→処方箋：06496_shohousen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{眼科|がんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I go to the ophthalmologist regularly to get my contact lens prescription.

notes:
USAGE:
In everyday speech, {眼科|がんか} refers both to the medical specialty and to the clinic itself. {眼科|がんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ means "to go to the eye doctor/clinic." The doctor is formally called {眼科医|がんかい}.
